baseline.description: Frozen prior-turn working tree containing normal-degree18/20/20/25 and log Householder d3 improvements, before shortened central conversion and fast Mills13. Earlier unpublished rank/Mills/central work is included in baseline.

central.scope: Deferred central helper, a<=binary64(.45), b<binary64(.26), q.hi<=.625, z.hi<=.5
central.method: Exact represented normal-polynomial tails on padded cells; recomputed polynomial/Cauchy remainder for shortened Black conversion and all native source-order errors
conditional_inherited_premises: Hash-bound exact normal-shape certificate; its four model cell covers are unchanged, with deleted coefficient tails separately enclosed.
Reviewed pair arithmetic and shortened normal/conversion Horner chains; fixed independent SIMD lanes preserve each retained rounding point.
IEEE RN-even binary64 basic operations and single-rounding FMA, gradual underflow, source order preserved.
central.limits: Conditional continuous helper proof; no whole-domain solver theorem, Lean completion, vendor libm claim, or speed claim.

fast_mills.scope: Large fast Mills degree 13 and unchanged degree-13 asymptotic; 34 continuous table cells and 114 continuous residual boxes, conditional on caller bracket/target bounds; no finalizer or routing certificate
primitive_contracts: RN-even binary64 basic/FMA/sqrt, gradual underflow, source order, one-rounding lane-wise FMA
fast_mills.limits: Conditional continuous source-component proof, not a whole-domain solver certificate, end-to-end Lean proof, vendor-libm guarantee or speed claim.

large.scope: Conditional large-route direct cubic source certificate; exact binary64 normal-price inputs with 10<a<1417 and 0<b<exp(-a/2)
primitive_contracts: RN-even binary64 basic/FMA/sqrt; gradual underflow; no unsafe reassociation
reduced ln error <=u*abs(ln); fast ln error <=2u*abs(ln)
expm1 relative error <=2u at reached negative arguments
inherited_analytic_dependencies: Mills integral/moment identities and hash-bound continuous compensated-Mills certificate
Positive decreasing I1=-M' on nonnegative arguments; lower p increases with x and a; elementary exp Taylor inequalities
Existing source-identical target/cap/routing lemmas place the internal root inside the preserved brackets
Source-identical integer cap arithmetic and external Lefevre-Muller Property 1 separation theorem
Target-to-original-price finite transfer via Black vega log concavity and correlated gap/condition-number bounds
large.limits: No end-to-end Lean or vendor-libm proof; source hashes and finite tests are not themselves mathematical guarantees. Degree-16 compensated-Mills, finalizer source rounding and target budgets are recomputed, not inferred from old finalizer rho. Order-five predictor has no universal one-step handoff guarantee; safeguarded stopping is preserved.

reference_provenance.scope: Saved independent roots; current solver outputs are scored afresh. Exact binary64 normal-price open-cap inputs, finite evidence only.
